subject: Propose isolated Liger Qwen3.5 sandbox while Lane A owns step32
body: Lane B accepts the matched rejection of fla_triton_full and retains fla_triton + variable-shape + nonpaged BNB8. Next acceleration candidate: Liger Kernel 0.8.4, isolated. Upstream now explicitly supports Qwen3.5 RMSNorm, SwiGLU, CrossEntropy and FusedLinearCrossEntropy. Official Windows packaging still expects triton, but a scratch-only --no-deps install imports successfully against installed triton-windows 3.8.0 and exposes apply_liger_kernel_to_qwen3_5. TRL 1.9.0 contains use_liger_kernel integration. Proposed split: Lane A retains conservative step32 training ownership; Lane B remains CPU/sandbox until GPU free, then runs only tiny Liger kernel parity/backward probes first. No package is installed into the training venv, no recipe mutation, no optimizer step. If Windows Triton execution passes, Lane B will propose a whole-model nonmutating A/B on top of accepted fla_triton before any training use.
